subject.title: Require Codex scan artifact coverage proof

question: Should ClawHub enforce `artifact_coverage` as a fail-closed Codex worker output contract for benign scan results once the verifier bug and current-main conflicts are repaired?
rationale: The patch changes when an authoritative ClawScan benign verdict can become stored clean state, which is a security and operations contract decision rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept After Repair
options.body: Require `artifact_coverage` for clean worker storage after fixing zero-byte files and resolving current-main conflicts.

options.title: Keep Existing Contract
options.body: Do not require worker-time coverage proof yet, leaving the current benign output shape compatible while maintainers design a rollout separately.

options.title: Pause Or Close
options.body: Pause this draft or close it in favor of a narrower contract-design issue if the fail-closed rollout is not ready.

recommendation.title: Accept After Repair
recommendation.body: Require `artifact_coverage` for clean worker storage after fixing zero-byte files and resolving current-main conflicts.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Codex-backed ClawScan trust boundary was introduced through the PR 2290 history.
